title: Normalizing State
description: Learn how to structure state for efficient updates.

data.text: **Normalizing state** means storing entities in an object keyed by ID, like a database. This makes updates efficient and consistent.

data.title: Normalization
Entity Adapter
data.text: Redux Toolkit's createEntityAdapter handles normalization automatically.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Normalized state is more efficient and consistent.
